## Problem and users

Who needs this, and what are they trying to decide?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the workflow and how we could verify it works.

## Evidence and constraints

What data supports it? Note coverage, uncertainty, licensing, privacy, and
validation needs. Do not paste private records or imply unavailable data exists.
